nodeTypes.description: Converts mechanical rotor angle to wrapped electrical angle using pole count, direction, and offset.

EncoderSign.description: Fallback encoder direction multiplier when the input is not wired.

OffsetDeg.description: Fallback electrical-angle calibration offset in degrees when the input is not wired.

Poles.description: Fallback motor pole count when the input is not wired.

nodeTypes.description: Generates a continuously advancing electrical angle for open-loop control.

Angle.description: Persistent generated angle state in radians.

RateRadPerS.description: Electrical angular velocity in radians per second.

nodeTypes.description: Exposes a named configuration value, using a default when no stored value is available.
nodeTypes.inlineCode: Value = Cached;

outputPorts.description: Cached configuration value supplied to the graph.
outputPorts.name: Value

Cached.description: Persistent cached configuration value exposed by the output.

DefaultValue.description: Value used when the configuration key has not been stored.

Key.description: Name used to look up the value in platform configuration storage.

nodeTypes.description: Proportional-integral controller with output clamping, back-calculation anti-windup, and an optional feed-forward term.

inputPorts.description: Measured process value subtracted from the setpoint.
inputPorts.name: Measurement

inputPorts.description: Optional additive feed-forward value. Wired voltage sources are extracted automatically; unconnected ports default to zero.
inputPorts.name: Feedforward

AwGain.description: Back-calculation anti-windup gain. Zero disables anti-windup.

Feedforward.description: Default value used when the Feedforward input port is not connected.

Ki.description: Integral gain applied to the accumulated error.

Kp.description: Proportional gain applied to the current error.

OutputMax.description: Upper output clamp, additionally limited by the measured DC-link voltage.

OutputMin.description: Lower output clamp, additionally limited by the measured DC-link voltage.
